references.text: This earlier list of cities given to the tribe of Judah includes Beersheba and Moladah, which were later redistributed to the tribe of Simeon.
Beersheba is mentioned here as the place where Abraham and Abimelech made a covenant, giving the city's name historical significance.
Isaac also gave the name Beersheba to a well, confirming the city's importance in the history of the patriarchs.
This list in Chronicles confirms that Beersheba and Moladah belonged to the descendants of Simeon.
After the exile, the descendants of Judah settled again in Beersheba and Moladah.
